note: Measured by the builder agent with `cargo bench -p dioxus-compose-markdown --bench streaming` and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2. Values are the lines the bench prints.

binary_size_increase.note: Measure a sample built with and without a Markdown in it, per platform.

Measured on macOS aarch64 (Apple M1, macOS 26.5.1) as release builds with `--features dioxus-compose/mock-renderer`, so no native renderer is linked into either binary. Each value is the byte size of the example binary. Other platforms are not measured yet.

unchanged_sample.note: Built with dioxus-compose-markdown as a workspace member and again with it removed from the members; both builds produce the same SHA-256 (03e2c0098e0e7c05570121b5bfba21dd740745c05c9c9752c61232ce5ab53f38). The markdown crate is not in its dependency tree.
